decisions.title: Credit a merge commit only when it introduced the blamed commit
decisions.rationale: A plain ancestry-path search credits any later merge on the mainline, so an unrelated PR's branch name became the line's change id. A candidate merge now qualifies only when its first parent does not already contain the commit; this uses one read-only git log call.

decisions.title: Resolve supersession over raw and canonical change ids
decisions.rationale: extract_decisions keys archived changes by their dated directory name, while supersedes references are usually written with the canonical id. The script builds the owner's supersession map twice, once per id form, rather than writing a second resolver.

decisions.title: Tier the OPTIONAL evidence_level prompt line after the required-vocabulary sentence
decisions.rationale: Placing it before 'use exactly one value from each listed set' would read as required; the line follows it and says to omit the field when unsure.
